$comment: Local non-secret Concordia settings. Copy this file to concordia.config.json and keep machine-specific values out of Git.

server.$comment: Backend bind host and port. CONCORDIA_HOST and CONCORDIA_PORT may override these values.

web.$comment: Vite port and external host names. localhost and 127.0.0.1 are always allowed.

glabUnityHub.$comment: GLab-UnityHub (spec/feature/glab-unity-hub.md). Non-secret settings only. Tokens/keys never go here: Discord uses the Concordia Discord settings, Notion uses env CC_NOTION_TOKEN_<credentialKey>, GitHub uses gh auth. Env GLAB_UNITY_HUB_* overrides guildId/port/allowedCountries/geoPolicy.
